Residences designed to make the everyday extraordinary. 
 THE WASHINGTON, located on a key corner in New Haven's historic Ninth Square, is a lifestyle hot spot surrounded by fabulous restaurants, theaters, galleries, shops and just steps from Yale University, Yale New Haven Hospital, and various federal/state/municipal buildings. One block away, the beautiful and historic New Haven Green offers a peaceful outdoor place to relax in the sun or enjoy one of the many summer concerts or cultural events held there.  Restored to Glory. 
 Rich in history and character, The Washington has been proudly redeveloped and restored by The Hurley Group, a local developer with decades of experience in real estate development and management, and The Building Studio Architects of New York, an architectural firm with vast experience in the restoration of historical landmarks. The ornate brick and masonry facade, ornate metal railings, hand carved wood trim and period mosaic tile in the entry and hallways have all been thoroughly restored to their original magnificence.* Energy efficient windows, exterior lighting and retail storefronts have all been chosen to authentically replicate the original style. Attractive apartment homes occupy the upper floors, each constructed to blend historic elements with contemporary details for the utmost charm and style. The result is a perfect merger of historic character, modern finishes and industrial accents. 
 *In keeping with tradition, all restorations meet or exceed the guidelines set by the U.S. Parks Service standards for historic buildings rehabilitation. 
 Luxury Living. 
 The Washington offers unique, loft style studio and one-bedroom residences in a variety of spacious floor plans. Each attractively designed residence feature numerous architectural details that are so unique, no two are the same. All apartment homes are appointed with designer wood floors, tall ceilings, large scale or unique windows, fully equipped gourmet kitchens, stainless steel appliances, European cabinetry with center island, quartz counter-tops, spa-inspired bathrooms with full size tubs, washer/dryers, ceiling fans, window shades and high efficiency heating/cooling units. 
 More Than Just Apartment Homes.

All floors are conveniently accessed by an elevator or the grand, marble staircase while state of the art safety and security features provide peace of mind. Each floor includes a trash and recycling station. The lower level offers a fitness room flanked by turn of the century skylights, a comfortable community/party room with HDTV and wifi, recreation area with billiards and table tennis, a pet grooming station, storage compartments and bicycle room.
